discrete_audit.boundary: shared apertures close wall/seam flux; no separate mobility wall flux
discrete_audit.conditioning: A=I has condition number 1; no inverse mobility or zero-mobility preconditioner
discrete_audit.conservation: sum(V*div(face_flux)) telescopes; implicit identity adds no exchange at M=0
discrete_audit.implicit: A=I+h*M*eps*L^2; L=V_safe^-1*K; solve A*phi_new=b in the V inner product
discrete_audit.legacy_unexecuted: projection_legacy FFT denominator=1+h*M*eps*m2^2; at zero it is 1; not selected
discrete_audit.limitations: Finite fields/geometry only; discrete advection persists; no material-velocity claim.
discrete_audit.momentum: rhs retains +(SIGMA_NORM/We)*mu*grad(phi)/rho_l, viscosity, advection, gravity flag
discrete_audit.normalization: CG floors/denominators depend on rhs/residual, not 1/M; zero residual skips body
discrete_audit.pressure_and_Brinkman: unchanged damping then frozen central-D/G periodic pressure projection
discrete_audit.zero_limit: J_CH=0, A=I, correction_rhs=b-A*b=0; zero CG iterations, phi_new=b
